verdict.rationale: Oneleet's frameworks page names SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS and GDPR on its 'all-in-one platform.' The compliance docs describe frameworks sharing controls within one workspace, where a control stays if another framework requires it. Pricing is 'one price, everything included' with no per-framework fees. Together this supports adding new frameworks without a new tool. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs for HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS (control sets, audit workflows), explicit documentation of adding a framework and how controls map across frameworks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
